rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance just cause eviction requirement
rules.requirement: A landlord may evict a tenant from a unit covered by the Rent Ordinance only for one of 17 enumerated just causes, which must be the dominant motive for the eviction. Expiration of a rental agreement or a change in ownership is not just cause.

coverage_conditions.summary: Rental units covered by the SF Rent Ordinance. Eviction protections also extend to some units exempt from the rent increase limits, such as units first receiving a Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979, Costa-Hawkins-eligible tenancies, and some tenancies regulated by other agencies.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Applies to units covered by the Rent Ordinance, including some units exempt from its rent increase limits.

rules.interaction: Some tenancies exempt from the Ordinance's rent increase limitations (post-June 13, 1979 Certificate of Occupancy units, Costa-Hawkins tenancies, some government-regulated tenancies) remain subject to its eviction provisions.
rules.quoted_span: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction.

rules.title: Just cause required to remove housing services
rules.requirement: A landlord needs just cause to take away or remove access to certain housing services such as garage and parking facilities, driveways, storage spaces and laundry rooms. A landlord who complies with Ordinance Section 37.2(r) may temporarily remove certain services such as parking and storage to perform mandatory soft-story seismic retrofit work.

coverage_conditions.summary: Housing services in units covered by the Rent Ordinance.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Applies to housing services including garage, parking, driveways, storage spaces and laundry rooms.

rules.exemptions: Temporary removal of certain housing services (parking, storage) for mandatory soft-story seismic retrofit work by a landlord who has complied with Section 37.2(r).
